codes.ROLE_CANNOT_WRITE: {role} can't {actions} here: those options are hidden for them.

codes.SECRET_COLUMN_SHOWN: {columns} look like secrets and show in the grid: hide them, or deny the field in the roles' permissions.
codes.WIDGET_IGNORES_ROW_FILTER: The widget {widget} reads {resource}, which {role} may read only some rows of, but its SQL never filters by $USER: {role} sees every row through it.
